Package ch.colabproject.colab.api.model.token

Class SharingLinkToken

java.lang.Object
ch.colabproject.colab.api.model.token.Token
ch.colabproject.colab.api.model.token.SharingLinkToken
All Implemented Interfaces:
ColabEntity, TokenWithURL, WithDeletionStatus, WithPermission, WithTrackingData, WithId, WithJsonDiscriminator, Serializable
@Entity public class SharingLinkToken extends Token
A token to share a project. The goal is to have a URL to send to people in order to allow them to view the project and take part of the edition of a specific card.

The user must be authenticated.

If the user is not yet a member of the project, he becomes a guest team member.

If a card is specified, the user will gain a support task allowing him to write in the card.

The link has no expiration. But it can be manually deleted.

Author:
sandra
